formulas.hosting_planned_cents: Four dated components total11270 per month, plus the separately sourced N01 hosting_extras input; unknown extras keep the complete planned cost unknown.
formulas.hosting_annual_cents: Known component subtotal11270*12=135240; alternative all-in N01 ceiling20000*12=240000 replaces those components plus N01 usage/monitoring/taxes/restore overlap/contingency, never additive.
formulas.scaled_monthly_cost: round_half_up(base_monthly_cash_cost_cents * scenario.workload_multiplier_bps /10000), independently per line/month; null input stays null
formulas.host_fee: round_half_up(explicit_qualifying_host_fee_base_cents * selected_host_fee_bps/10000); base and applicable rate must be known, except structural no-host cases. The base is not summed as income and must match the selected host's donated/incoming/processed-revenue scope.
formulas.one_time: A positive amount with known timing appears once in month1..12; unknown timing leaves all months null. A known month with unknown amount leaves only that month null. Explicit known zero has no timing cost.
formulas.known_subtotal: Sum only known cost entries; this is a partial arithmetic subtotal, not complete expenses or a zero for missing costs
formulas.complete_total: Sum every scoped cost only if all are known; otherwise null. Annual complete totals require every month.
formulas.contingency: Optional allowance = round_half_up(contingency_base_cents * contingency_bps/10000). Base is the complete monthly cash-cost total less any all-in N01 ceiling, which already includes its own contingency; unknown complete cost or unset policy stays null.
formulas.liquidity_reserve: Optional end-state cash stock = round_half_up(complete_annual_recurring_cash_cost * reserve_months/12); one-time fees/assets excluded; not added twelve times or treated as income/expense
formulas.funding: Each measure gets its own twelve-month strict sum. No unrestricted/restricted availability or donor-compliance allocation is inferred.
formulas.rounding: Integer cents and nonnegative rational arithmetic only; nearest cent with exact halves upward at each line/month. Annual sums use the rounded monthly entries.
